# function: oid_name

Returns the friendly name for a dotted object identifier that is a well-known DN attribute, extension, or extended key usage — for example `oid_name("2.5.4.4")` returns `surname`.

Errors on an unknown OID rather than returning an empty string, so a typo fails at plan time instead of silently omitting a DN attribute.

Use the `pki_oids` data source when you need to iterate over the table.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Render an OID from a decoded certificate as a human-readable name.
data "pki_certificate" "example" {
  content_pem = file("device.crt")
}

output "first_subject_attribute" {
  value = provider::pki::oid_name(data.pki_certificate.example.subject[0].oid)
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
oid_name(oid string) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `oid` (String) A dotted OID such as `2.5.4.3` or `2.5.29.17`.
